en.topic_title: China supports Brazil in opposing ‘interference’: Xi to Lula
en.topic_summary:
Chinese President Xi Jinping told his Brazilian counterpart on Monday that he supports the country in “opposing external interference”, Beijing’s state media said, reporting a call between the leaders.



Chinese President Xi Jinping meets Brazilian President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva during a visit to Brazil in November 2024. File photo: Presidência da República do Brasil, via Facebook.
